patch_description: Replace the concentric-ring layout (sum ≈ 0.96) with an explicit hexagonal-lattice construction of 26 circles, and replace the greedy radius scaling with an exact linear program. A triangular lattice with spacing 0.2 horizontally and 0.1·√3 vertically supports rows of 6,5,6,5,6 circles of radius 0.1 (28 total); dropping two adjacent circles from the middle row gives n=26 and leaves a growth hole. For fixed centers, maximizing Σr subject to border-distance and pairwise-distance constraints is a linear program solved exactly via scipy, with a converged multi-pass scaler as fallback. Expected sum ≈ 2.6+, near the AlphaEvolve target of 2.635.
